name: imports-sort
description: Sort PHP use and JS/TS/Vue import statements shortest to longest, preserving sections
author: Martin Shaw <hello@martinshaw.co>

importsSort.sortOnSave.description: Automatically sort imports when a supported file is saved.

importsSort.fileExtensions.description: File extensions where Imports Sort should run (command and sort-on-save).

importsSort.separateTypeImports.description: Move `import type` statements into their own section after other ESM imports (before CSS).

importsSort.separateCssImports.description: Move CSS/SCSS/etc. imports into their own section at the end of the import block.

importsSort.quoteStyle.description: Normalize ESM module-specifier quotes. `detect` uses the majority style in the import region.

importsSort.semicolons.description: Normalize trailing semicolons on import/`use` statements. `detect` uses the majority style in the import region.

importsSort.collapseMultilineImports.description: When enabled, collapse multi-line named imports to one line (or expand single-line imports that exceed the max length).

importsSort.collapseMultilineMaxLength.description: Max preferred line length when collapseMultilineImports is enabled.
